ns2:section.sectionText: This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design. This class will be structured so that students can expect to meet in class for one full class period each week as permitted, in half class socially distanced groups. All other instruction will be done remotely. All assignments will be synchronized with online information and in class studio time. All assignments will be designed so that they can be worked remotely.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media major(s).
